mostWorthwhile.text: Filtering the blood and then recovering useful substances made the kidney's two-stage job clear. The filter lets glucose through, so taking it back matters.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the ureters and bladder was straightforward but less engaging than discovering what happens to the filtered fluid.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the filter lets useful glucose through rather than picking out only waste.

arbitrary.text: None felt especially arbitrary: the pictures and goals explained the pairings, including the named drainage slots.

continue.text: I would choose to try another chapter because the filtering-and-recovery process showed an interesting job that was not obvious from the organ names alone.
